# Chrome boxes of absolutely positioned elements (M3-T1 probe 1, for M3-04/M3-02)
# Source: tmp/m3probe/positioned.html (dev-only probe page, never committed to Go code), 2026-11-24, run by tmp/m3probe/run.sh: chromium --headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --dump-dom,
# as Chromium 156.0.8078.73 built on Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) (headless, getBoundingClientRect). Units: CSS px.
# Format: {"name","w" (container width, CSS px),"css","html"} reproduce the case; every rect is [x,y,w,h] of the border box relative to the case container (a display:flow-root div at the page origin, margin 0), 3 decimals (Blink LayoutUnit = 1/64 px); "m" border boxes by key (key ending [] = all matches in tree order), "t" first client rect of the element text (Range), "cs" computed style values (pseudo-elements are read with getComputedStyle(el, "::x")), "m0" the same rects as "m" with every transform neutralised, "x" extra values. The first line {"meta":...} gives the viewport (innerWidth, innerHeight = A4 794x1123 CSS px).
# Template CSS is tmp/m3probe/tpl.css = the <style> of testdata/templates/02-executive.html.tmpl (verbatim); "02 ..." cases use its classes.
# Cases named "... @prod" repeat the "02" cases at the production layout width 170mm/0.9 = 713.9108px (page area at Scale 0.9, paper-only harness); the others use 170mm = 642.5197px (Scale 1).
# "rel ..." cases: abs box inside a relative, padded (10px 15px), bordered (3px) 300x200 parent at x=40; "static ..." the same parent without position: the containing block is the initial containing block (794x1123 at the page origin, see meta).
# insets use 7/11/13/17px for top/right/bottom/left; size = auto or 50x40 variants. Text content: "abc def" in a 16px DejaVu Serif/Sans line (the static position follows 30px block + text).
# Pseudo-elements cannot be measured through getBoundingClientRect: ".cover::after" and ".finding::before" are given by getComputedStyle(el, '::after'/'::before') used values (width, height, left, top, right, bottom) and by a stand-in element with the same CSS (rect in "m").
# The 02 stamp: "m".stamp is the rotated bounding box, "m0".stamp the unrotated border box, cs.stamp.transform the computed matrix (rotate(-4deg)).
